debugger.program.hint: Path to the built application to debug (the project's compiled output); absolute, or relative to the working directory.
debugger.runtimeArguments.hint: Arguments passed to the runtime host before the program.
debugger.runtimeExecutable.hint: Runtime host used to launch the program. Defaults to 'dotnet' (or 'mono' for the Mono type); provide an absolute path or a command available on PATH.
debugger.sourceFileMap.hint: A mapping of local source file paths to the paths expected by the debugger. A list of path mappings in the format { "location during compilation": "actual location" }.

settings.resharper.completion.fullComple: Time (in ms) to wait for the full completion list. If not ready after this time, a partial list is returned immediately, and additional suggestions will appear on the next typing.

settings.resharper.editor.enterMovesToNe: When enabled, pressing Enter inside a snippet placeholder moves to the next placeholder instead of inserting a new line
settings.resharper.editor.moveCursorAfte: Move the cursor when applying formatting edits after typing. Only applies when `#editor.formatOnType#` is enabled.
settings.resharper.nuget.includePrerelea: Include prerelease versions of packages in search result
